## How the SM2524XT Powers Next-Generation Edge AI Storage

[Contact Us](https://www.siliconmotion.com/support/contact/sales)


As edge AI applications continue to evolve, storage performance and power efficiency are becoming increasingly important. Silicon Motion's SM2524XT PCIe Gen5 Edge SSD Controller is designed to meet these demands with full PCIe Gen5 performance in a 4-channel DRAM-less architecture.


In this DigiTimes interview, Product Manager Eunice Chen explains how the SM2524XT is optimized for AI inference and KV Cache workloads, delivering exceptional performance, low power consumption, and low, consistent latency. She also shares the latest updates on Silicon Motion's PCIe Gen5 SSD controller portfolio and how it is enabling the next generation of edge AI devices.


Watch the full interview to learn more.
